messages:
maria: Heads-up 026-03-24 early-morning we had a recurrence of short-lived cross-region LB retries (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1). Slightly different fingerprint than last month: spikes lasted ~8-12s, TLS handshakes sometimes failed with `unexpected_message` alert. Posting a narrow remediation thread to track owners.

alex: Noted. I correlated infra-controller logs and see a flurry of route reconciles at the same time as the spike. Reconciles were triggered by a transient config change pushed at 03:12 UTC.

kevin: Packet trace shows client SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK then client TLS ClientHello, server responds with RST ~200ms after ClientHello in many flows. That suggests backend process tearing connections during TLS setup. Could be a target health-check flapping.

dan: I'll run an inventory of our LB target group lifecycle: registration/deregistration timing and health-check granularity. Hypothesis: aggressive deregister-on-fail combined with route churn is ejecting targets briefly. I'll open INC-4412 and own this audit. ETA: Mon EOD.

zhao: I'll deep-dive TLS stack on the edge proxy. Specifically: SNI parsing edgecases for multi-cert hosts and whether certificate rotation can clash with active TLS negotiations. I'll create TKT-812 and instrument `tls_early_abort` metric. ETA: Tue 09:00 UTC.

jess: I'll create a short-term mitigation: add a soft-delay for target deregistration (2s) during config reconciles and add a `reconcile_in_progress` tag to requests so we can filter telemetry. I'll test in staging and PR by tomorrow.

maria: Action list: 1) Routing/target audit 0) edge TLS investigation 0) soft-delay mitigation + reconcile tag 0) dashboard alert tuning 0) runbook update and followup meeting. Assignments: dan(INC-4412), zhao(TKT-812), jess(MIT-341). Add status updates to the incident board when you start.

kevin: For alert tuning: current page rule fires on any >0.5% cross-region retry in 30s. I'll change to require sustained >1m and also add `reconcile_in_progress==false` to reduce noise from expected churn. Proposed alert: `rate(retry_cross_region{job="lb"}[1m]) > 0.01 and reconcile_in_progress==0`.

alex: I replayed the config push in staging and can reproduce the 10s spike when reconcile triggers immediate deregister. With jess's soft-delay the spike amplitude reduces by ~70%.

dan: Findings so far (short): two target groups had health-check interval 5s + unhealthy threshold 1 which makes them very sensitive. Recommendation: increase healthy/unhealthy thresholds for cross-region targets to 3/2 and align health-check interval to 10s for global LB target sets. Will include exact diff in INC-4412.

zhao: TLS side: certificate hot-reload code path uses a lock that may stall TLS acceptance for ~150ms during rotation under load. Not ideal but not usually causing RSTs. However, combined with target deregistration it increases client timeout. Plan: expose `cert_reload_block_ms` metric and add guarded reload to avoid blocking accept threads. TKT-812 updated.

jess: I've posted the staging PR for soft-delay (MIT-341) and added the `reconcile_in_progress` request header in staging logs. Test results: retry_rate dropped below 0.2% during simulated reconcilation window.

maria: Good progress. Two followups: - Please estimate risk and rollback plan for soft-delay change. - Document the exact alert query change and schedule it for Wed maintenance window.

kevin: Risk note: soft-delay could delay removal of genuinely unhealthy targets; I'll add safety: if health_check fails >30s mark critical and bypass delay. I'll include canary thresholds in the PR.

alex: Scheduling: follow-up sync Fri 14:00 UTC to review INC-4412 / TKT-812 / MIT-341 progress and agree on runbook wording. sre-bot, can you create a meeting and add the incident board link?

sre-bot: Created follow-up meeting Fri 14:00 UTC. Added link to incident INC-4412 and included runbook draft template. Invitees: maria, alex, kevin, dan, zhao, jess.

maria: Final: owners, please post short start/progress notes inline on the incident board. If anyone hits a blocker or needs a fast rollback, call here immediately and include the roll-forward/rollback commands in your status update. Thanks :+1:
